identity.title: Pokémon: Beyond the Skies of the Adventure

leadText:
Pokémon: Beyond the Skies of the Adventure (Italian: Pokémon: oltre i cieli dell'avventura) is the opening theme song for the dub of the second season of as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from EP052 to EP105 (to EP116 in the first airing). It is sung, at some points, to the tune of the first opening theme.

The opening animation mainly consists of clips from various episodes of the season, but also footage from the first two English themes Pokémon Theme and .

==Trivia==
This is the only Italian theme song for which the shortened TV version features a part of the lyrics not present in the extended version. However, this part is present in the full version. 
The " " subtitle that shows up under the "Pokémon" logo doesn't appear during the ending credits.
Giorgio Vanni revealed that he was the one who came up with the line " " in the first verse. It was proposed to Alessandra Valeri Manera, who kept it and wrote the rest of the song.
